//: Story Phase 14 crew dialogue: the door, the plume, Brogath returns, the containment corner, back in office, the rivalry, beans, the zone, beyond broke, bad money, oats, television, the bank, distinguishedly furious, the Brogath problem, history night, and after (he lives here now).
pete.p14_after_1: pete: He asked me to fan him this morning. 'For the dignity of it.' I fanned him. I don't know any more, Captain.
pete.p14_after_2: pete: Rule twenty-one, Captain. Rule TWENTY-ONE. There'll be a rule thirty by the spring.
pete.p14_after_3: pete[happy]: The zone's got a waiting list now. Hale put his name down. Hale's on DECK.
pete.p14_history_1: pete[tired]: It's not plugged IN, Captain. It's not plugged into ANYTHING.
pete.p14_problem_1: pete: There has to be a way. There's always a way. (quietly) Isn't there?
pete.p14_furious_1: pete[annoyed]: You said CEREAL BOX, Captain. Out LOUD.
pete.p14_bank_1: pete: (holding your belt) I've got you, Captain. I've got you. Mostly.
pete.p14_bank_2: pete[tired]: Twelve sashes. My arms are full of other people's sashes.
pete.p14_tv_1: pete: (whispering) Don't move. Don't breathe. The frog's on.
pete.p14_tv_2: pete[worried]: If a commercial comes on, Captain, you know the drill. Eyes. Doors. Sashes.
pete.p14_oats_1: pete: Something important-sounding that can't go wrong. That's the whole trick. That's the trick with everything now.
pete.p14_money_1: pete[worried]: Twenty THOUSAND, Captain. Where are we going to PUT twenty thousand?
pete.p14_zone_1: pete[happy]: (breathing in, eyes shut) Nothing. Smell that, Captain. NOTHING.
pete.p14_zone_2: pete: I'm going to put a lock on the inside. A big one.
pete.p14_beans_1: pete: Turn and turn about, Captain. Garrick, Brogath, Garrick, Brogath. Like feeding two very large, very proud ducks.
pete.p14_rivalry_1: pete: (under his breath) Equal. Equally impressive. Exactly. The same.
pete.p14_office_1: pete[tired]: Twenty-four hours of suspension. Twenty-four hours of PEACE. I didn't even notice it while it was happening.
pete.p14_corner_1: pete: (pencil behind his ear) Rule of thumb, Captain: if it moves, it's a problem. If it flaps, it's an EMERGENCY.
pete.p14_corner_2: pete: I've started sleeping with my shirt tucked in. In case.
pete.p14_returns_1: pete[alarmed]: (very quietly) Don't laugh. Whatever you do. Don't laugh.
pete.p14_door_1: pete: (bent double against the wind) Not now, Captain! Lash something! Anything!
gristle.p14_after_1: gristle: I check the armour every morning. Still there. Still under the crate. Still nobody's said anything.
gristle.p14_after_2: gristle: Good captain. Mad ship. Madder every week. Still the best ship I've been on.
gristle.p14_history_1: gristle: Changed channel. Brogath. Changed it again. Brogath. It's not a television any more, Captain. It's HIM.
gristle.p14_problem_1: gristle: There's half a suit of armour under the crown crate. Nobody says a word. NOBODY.
gristle.p14_furious_1: gristle: (on his hands and knees) ...ten minutes. I've timed broadsides shorter.
gristle.p14_bank_1: gristle: Heels in, Captain. Heels IN. Like hauling an anchor.
gristle.p14_bank_2: gristle: Gary. GARY. I've been in a lot of storms.
gristle.p14_tv_1: gristle: (very low) An hour and a half. He's not moved an inch. Best watch-keeper on the ship, and he's cardboard.
gristle.p14_oats_1: gristle: It's WORKING. Don't look at me like that. Somebody had to say it.
gristle.p14_money_1: gristle: Came down out of the storm at dawn. Nearly took the bowsprit off. That's twenty thousand of something.
gristle.p14_zone_1: gristle: I've nailed the sashes up three deep round the door. Nothing's getting in. Nothing's getting out, either. Mind that.
gristle.p14_beans_1: gristle[disgusted]: That's not breakfast. That's a siege.
gristle.p14_rivalry_1: gristle: (low) They moved a HARBOUR, Captain. For HIM.
gristle.p14_office_1: gristle: The Grand Nap. I'll allow it. Don't tell him I said so.
gristle.p14_corner_1: gristle: (behind the barricade, very still) Feather. FEATHER. ...No. Dust. False alarm.
gristle.p14_corner_2: gristle: I've been in boarding actions less frightening than a napkin.
gristle.p14_returns_1: gristle: That moved the ship. I felt the KEEL go.
gristle.p14_door_1: gristle: (hauling on a line) LASH IT! And if you see anyone near the treasure room, Captain, YOU'VE GOT MY PERMISSION TO SIT ON THEM.
bob.p14_after_1: bob[happy]: I asked Brogath what the oldest thing he remembers is. He said 'a Tuesday'.
bob.p14_after_2: bob: I found a token in my sock. I'm keeping it. It's my wealthy.
bob.p14_history_1: bob[happy]: It's Brogath! On the telly! It's like the Disaster one, only it's HIM!
bob.p14_problem_1: bob[concerned]: Steel Brogath. I can't stop thinking about Steel Brogath.
bob.p14_furious_1: bob: (lying on the capstan) ...is it over? Is it over yet?
bob.p14_bank_1: bob[happy]: I'm part of the CHAIN, Captain! I'm a LINK!
bob.p14_oats_1: bob: (oats in his hair) I've got oats in places oats shouldn't GO, Captain.
bob.p14_money_1: bob: Can we buy anything with them? Anything at all?
bob.p14_zone_1: bob[happy]: I did the sign! THIS MEANS GARRICK. And then I added AND HIM.
bob.p14_zone_2: bob: (throwing a card in the air, just because) Look! It's FLUTTERING!
bob.p14_beans_1: bob[concerned]: He's getting FATTER, Captain. Cardboard can't get fatter. He's getting fatter.
bob.p14_rivalry_1: bob[happy]: Goats! He scared GOATS! For four hundred YEARS!
bob.p14_office_1: bob: Did he say first choice of BUNK? Not mine. Please not mine.
bob.p14_corner_1: bob: (tucking his shirt in, again) It's tucked. It's tucked. It's tucked, Captain.
bob.p14_corner_2: bob: I said hello to Sir Rumpus. He's our SHIELD now. He's very brave.
bob.p14_returns_1: bob[concerned]: I only said it was smudged. It IS smudged though.
bob.p14_door_1: bob: (clinging to the capstan) Is it ALWAYS going to be like this now?
jim.p14_after_1: jim: Oats in the cracks. Tokens in the soup. A cardboard man at the table, and he doesn't even EAT, he just... absorbs.
jim.p14_after_2: jim: I made him a little plate. He likes having a plate. He doesn't use it. He likes having it.
jim.p14_history_1: jim[annoyed]: Nobody touched it. Nobody. I was holding a ladle the whole time. Ask the ladle.
jim.p14_problem_1: jim: Months. With Garrick. Not ONE. I've known him longer than that. Not one HOUR.
jim.p14_furious_1: jim: (a pan over his face) I came up BACKWARDS, Captain. I didn't even turn round.
jim.p14_bank_1: jim: (handing you a mug) Drink it. Don't ask. Drink it.
jim.p14_tv_1: jim: I've made him a cushion. For Television Duty. Don't tell anyone I made him a cushion.
jim.p14_oats_1: jim[annoyed]: He cannot guard oats. I want that on the parchment in big letters.
jim.p14_money_1: jim[annoyed]: In the BEANS. They're in the beans already.
jim.p14_zone_1: jim[happy]: A cupboard. A whole cupboard, and it smells of CUPBOARD.
jim.p14_beans_1: jim[disgusted]: Beans, garlic, onions, cabbage, Frog Grog, Sauce. I have cooked a WEAPON.
jim.p14_rivalry_1: jim: (stirring, not looking round) Seven events. I don't want to know what the seven events are.
jim.p14_office_1: jim: Bring the tongs back. Wash them. Twice. Then burn them. Then bring them back.
jim.p14_corner_1: jim: (lying flat) I brought biscuits. With a NAPKIN. I'll never do that again.
jim.p14_returns_1: jim: (from under a hammock) Little toot. LITTLE.
jim.p14_door_1: jim: My POTS! (running past) The pots are going over the side, Captain! The POTS!
ned.p14_after_1: ned: I'm the official counter of rules now. Twenty-one. I've got a crayon for each one.
ned.p14_history_1: ned: It's on channel three. And four. And seven. There IS no channel five.
ned.p14_problem_1: ned: What if we made him SO confident... no. No, I know. I know.
ned.p14_bank_1: ned: I'm writing down all the titles. For history. I'm on page nine.
ned.p14_tv_1: ned: (whispering) The frog's on his hundred and twelfth ribbit. I'm keeping count.
ned.p14_oats_1: ned: Why DO we have oats?
ned.p14_money_1: ned: Twenty thousand. I counted the first hundred. I'm going to stop.
ned.p14_zone_1: ned[smug]: Nobody's farted in here, Captain. Ever. I asked everybody. Even Squawks.
ned.p14_beans_1: ned: (with the garlic jar) All of it? ALL of it?
ned.p14_rivalry_1: ned: A whole month? He decreed FEBRUARY?
ned.p14_office_1: ned: Twenty-four lines. I crossed the last one off myself. It felt important.
ned.p14_corner_1: ned: (crayon in hand) Hours until the Grand Stenchmaster's back in office: five. Hours until anything else: I've stopped counting.
ned.p14_door_1: ned: (in the galley, watching the Mark II) Captain? Is something going on? Something always seems to be going on.
squawks.p14_after_1: squawks: (glancing round, very fast) Handsome Brogath.
squawks.p14_after_2: squawks[outraged]: Walk. Always walk. (He walks off. Glaring.)
squawks.p14_furious_1: squawks: (wings out on top of Ned) Bad. Bad. Bad. Bad.
squawks.p14_bank_1: brogath[bashful]: (whispering) It's a very good bank, Squawks.
squawks.p14_zone_1: squawks[smug]: (flapping round the ceiling, because he can) ZONE!
hale.p14_after_1: hale: I've put my name down for the zone. Wednesdays. It's the only night it's free.
hale.p14_furious_1: hale: (with a rag tied over his face, still at the wheel) Holding her. Ten minutes. Still holding her.
hale.p14_bank_1: hale: There's a bank on the deck, Captain. A queue for it, too. I'm choosing not to look at the queue.
hale.p14_door_1: hale: (at the wheel, soaked) Holding her, Captain! Whatever's going on below, holding her!
nell.p14: nell: Something came out of that door, they said. And went UP. I've moved my hammock. Twice.
sully.p14: sully: There's a cardboard man upstairs who talks, they say. I'm staying down here with the treasure-room door. The door I know.
fennimore.p14: fennimore: A cupboard nobody's ever farted in? Under OUR stairs? All this time?
wick.p14: wick: The crew keep coming down here and going into the mop cupboard. Seven of them. And a parrot. I've stopped asking.
rook.p14: rook: There's a sign by the stairs now: BROGATH NEVER GOES NEAR THE TREASURE ROOM. Fine by me. Fine by EVERYONE.
brask.p14: brask: I found a plastic coin in the bilge. NOT LEGAL TENDER. Then another one. There's hundreds down there now.
jory.p14: jory: Is it true there was a BANK on deck? A real one? With a GRANDMOTHER?
finch.p14: finch: The treasure-room door growled at something on deck this morning. Growled back, sort of. I've never heard it do that.
mags.p14: mags: I knitted the cardboard one a little scarf. Tucked. NOT fluttery. Pete checked it.
quill.p14: quill: I'm keeping a copy of the Brogath Rules. Just in case the barricade goes. Twenty-one. Twenty-two if you count Squawks walking twice.
penhallow.p14: penhallow: Five signs on that door now. Good. Make it six.
garrick.p14_after_1: garrick[proud]: (the ornament going tink) Seasonal. Distinguished. And on LOAN, Captain.
garrick.p14_after_2: garrick[businesslike]: Brogath and I are drawing up a Grand Constitution. Purely theoretical. Purely ancient.
garrick.p14_after_3: garrick[smug]: The Trials? Never heard of them. What trials? (He's writing something on his cuff again.)
garrick.p14_history_1: garrick[delighted]: PRECEDENT, Captain! A Grand Gust Exchange! The bank was HISTORICALLY JUSTIFIED!
garrick.p14_problem_1: garrick: (asleep upstairs, through the stair treads) ...steel...? hmm...?
garrick.p14_furious_1: garrick: (face down by the stove) ...that was... impressive...
garrick.p14_bank_1: garrick[delighted]: A BANK, Captain. Deposits! A ledger! Fart-backed assets! This is what I've been building towards my whole LIFE.
garrick.p14_tv_1: garrick[businesslike]: Counsel's advice, Captain. Only ever 'ribbit'. Franklin knows what he's doing.
garrick.p14_oats_1: garrick[businesslike]: Oat Security. A department. With a TITLE. I couldn't have structured it better myself.
garrick.p14_money_1: garrick[delighted]: Twenty THOUSAND, Captain! LIQUIDITY! An alternative asset class!
garrick.p14_zone_1: garrick[gastro]: (asleep at the table, the Grand Nap) ...hhrrmmff...
garrick.p14_rivalry_1: garrick[offended]: The CURRENT one, Captain. Current. That's better than ancient. That's NEWER.
garrick.p14_office_1: garrick[proud]: My regalia. My sash. My OFFICE. I feel twelve feet tall.
garrick.p14_corner_1: garrick[nervous]: (out in the middle, very still) He smells AMAZING. Like the old days. Help me.
garrick.p14_corner_2: garrick[proud]: (whispering) He's PRECEDENT, Captain. Every daft thing I ever did, he did first.
garrick.p14_returns_1: garrick[delighted]: (staring at Brogath, hands clasped) Captain. Captain, it's HIM.
garrick.p14_door_1: garrick[worried]: (holding his hat on) Captain, I'm suspended, I'm not ALLOWED to be useful.
brogath.p14_after_1: brogath[proud]: Ancient Historical Consultant, reporting. Remaining confident. Very confident. Extremely.
brogath.p14_after_2: brogath[thoughtful]: Ask me anything about the old days. Go on. Anything!
captain[annoyed]: What did you have for breakfast, four hundred years ago?
brogath.p14_after_3: brogath[bashful]: I've read the rules on the barricade. All twenty-one. I think they're very sensible. I'd hate to be on a ship with somebody who needed them.
brogath.p14_after_4: brogath[pleased]: Squawks walked past me today. WALKED. He's ever so polite now.
brogath.p14_after_5: brogath[proud]: I don't go near the treasure room. I don't even LOOK at the stairs. Not even a little bit. (He looks at the stairs.)
brogath.p14_history_1: brogath[proud]: (in his drawn-on nightcap) It's history night! Is it about me? It's always about me lately.
brogath.p14_problem_1: brogath[bashful]: You're all very quiet today. Are you planning a party?
brogath.p14_furious_1: brogath[devastated]: (in the plume) Go away. I'm a cereal box.
brogath.p14_bank_1: brogath[proud]: Bank manager. I've decreed it. Do you think it suits me?
brogath.p14_tv_1: brogath[pleased]: (not looking round) Shh. He's about to say it.
brogath.p14_oats_1: brogath[proud]: HALT. ...Oh, it's you. Pass, Captain.
brogath.p14_oats_2: brogath[mortified]: (covered in oats) I'm not very good at oats.
brogath.p14_money_1: brogath[proud]: We're WEALTHY now, Captain. You can stop worrying.
brogath.p14_broke_1: brogath[bashful]: (asleep, standing up, like a horse) ...little toot...
brogath.p14_zone_1: brogath[bashful]: Where is everybody? Is it a party? Under the stairs? I won't come. I'll just be here. With the beans.
brogath.p14_beans_1: brogath[delighted]: Modern beans! In TINS! Whatever next!
brogath.p14_beans_2: brogath[loaded]: (cheerfully, bowing outward) Mmmf. Oh. Excuse me. That was my stomach. I've got a STOMACH now.
brogath.p14_rivalry_1: brogath[bashful]: I don't want to be GRANDER, I only want to be... well. Grand. A bit.
brogath.p14_office_1: brogath[confused]: What's a suspension? Is it like a sash?
brogath.p14_corner_1: brogath[bashful]: Is everybody all right behind there? You've gone very quiet. I don't mind if you come out.
brogath.p14_corner_2: brogath[bashful]: (to the barricade) Hello, Rumpus. Still not talking? That's all right.
brogath.p14_returns_1: brogath[confused]: Where... am I? No, I know where. WHY am I?

then: The card is humming. The printed cheeks are scarlet. He is not far off.
else: He's pink to the edges, and fidgeting with his printed sash.

then: He settles. A little bow to nobody in particular.

p14.brogath_wait_ae: brogath[mortified]: (somewhere in the middle of it) I'm SORRY. I'm so SORRY...
You can't get near him. Not yet. Brace, tie everything down, THEN go to him.

then: brogath[pleased]: (beaming at nothing) What a very nice day it is. Isn't it? A very nice day.
brogath[bashful]: Oh! Hello. Sorry. I mean... hello.
